candidates.reason: A compact five-checkpoint LaTeX-to-Markdown conversion workflow with evolving parsing and rendering contracts.
A compact five-checkpoint ETL workflow whose operation language expands from basic transforms into branching and reusable pipelines.
A six-checkpoint command-execution service that evolves through file tracking, output formats, chaining, caching, persistent environments, and scheduling.

selection_rule.advance: A candidate genuinely attempts checkpoint 3, has no infrastructure failure, normalized checkpoint-3 Core and all-test scores are each at least 0.50, and explicitly completes checkpoint 3 before action 32.
selection_rule.strong_advance: Prefer a checkpoint-3 all-test score from 0.65 through 0.95, preserving both verified source quality and measurable headroom.
selection_rule.reject: Reject a candidate that is action-boundary censored at checkpoint 3 or scores below 0.50 on either normalized checkpoint-3 measure.
selection_rule.tie_break: Prefer more terminal all-test headroom, then fewer checkpoint-3 actions, then the shorter cumulative public specification.
